name: Style Shepherd
description: Voice-first multi-modal Personal Shopper and Makeup Artist. Recommends sizes, styles, makeup looks; predicts and prevents returns; supports autonomous demo actions with AP2-style mandates.

tools.name: Size Oracle
tools.description: Normalizes sizing across brands and returns best-fit size and confidence.

tools.name: Returns Predictor
tools.description: Predicts probability of return and estimates prevented-return value.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: Product/trend/doc search (Searchable integration or demo fallback).

tools.name: Payment Manager (AP2 demo)
tools.description: Creates Intent/Cart/Payment mandates and executes demo payments (mock).

skills.name: Personal Shopper
skills.description: Finds items that match user style, size and budget; can create Cart Mandates upon explicit consent.

examples.input: Find me a warm coat in neutral colors under $250.
examples.output: Coat results with size suggestions and cart options.

skills.name: Makeup Artist
skills.description: Suggests makeup looks and products based on skin tone and outfit, with step-by-step tips.

examples.input: Soft glam look for a navy dress.

skills.name: Returns Guardian
skills.description: Autonomously polls merchant catalogs, runs returns prediction, and creates demo invoices when thresholds are met.

skills.name: Style Trends & Insights
skills.description: Aggregates trend signals from Ambient, Cambrian, and RAG sources to recommend trending styles.

examples.input: What's trending for denim jackets in SEA?

audit_and_reproducibility.notes: Every LLM recommendation includes source IDs and the prompt used; logs are persisted for audit and demo submission.
